description: This file declares data structures and function prototypes related to undoing resolve operations within a version control context, likely Git. It defines 'resolve_undo_info' structure, and functions for recording, reading, clearing, and unmerging resolve undo information in the index.

methods.name: record_resolve_undo
methods.description: Records undo information for a cache entry within the index.

methods.name: resolve_undo_write
methods.description: Serializes resolve undo information into a string buffer using specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: resolve_undo_read
methods.description: Reads and deserializes resolve undo information from a file into memory.

methods.name: resolve_undo_clear_index
methods.description: Clears any resolve undo information stored in the index.

methods.name: unmerge_index_entry
methods.description: Unmerges a specific index entry related to resolve undo information.

methods.name: unmerge_index
methods.description: Unmerges all entries in the index based on resolve undo information.
